name: Tarrier Foods Corporation
old_description: However, Ann quickly realized she had bigger ambitions and decided to take control of her own destiny. With determination and a trusted partner by her side, she stepped out and founded her own business - focused on mixing nuts and dried fruits.
about:
Tarrier Foods Corporation operates from Columbus, Ohio, as a family-owned food processor founded by Ann, who left a previous role to start her own business blending nuts and dried fruits. The company does not disclose a founding year, but describes decades of expertise in the ingredient space.

The company processes, blends, and packages sweet and savory inclusions and toppings for branded, private-label, and retail products. Its capabilities include simultaneous multi-item blending, size reduction, roasting, seasoning, and a range of packaging formats such as portion-control pouches, stand-up pouches, pillow pouches, bulk bag-in-box, bowls, and shakers. Tarrier also maintains a stocked inventory of branded inclusions—including OREO®, Chips Ahoy!®, Nutter Butter®, and Sour Patch Kids® Bitz—available for immediate shipment through distributor Dot Foods.

Tarrier serves food manufacturers, quick-service restaurant chains, distributors, and private-label brands across the United States and Canada. Its ingredients appear in desserts, baked goods, salads, and sandwiches. Long-term customers cite relationships spanning 11 to 20 years, highlighting the company’s role as an innovation partner for product development.

Tarrier emphasizes speed to market, custom formulation flexibility, and rigorous food safety controls as its differentiators. The founder’s original vision—to control her own destiny by creating unique ingredient blends—remains central to the company’s pitch: helping brands move faster from concept to production with tailored ingredient solutions.
